assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Stoneshard mod REVIEW pixel art, not an engine-ready sprite. Two DISTINCT adult spouses in four separated equal-width cells on a transparent background: cell1 ENA front view; cell2 SAME ENA side view; cell3 NARA seated front view; cell4 SAME NARA seated side view. ENA wears patched muted brown wool work dress and plain cream kerchief, holding a folded ordinary old brown work coat, not a burial shroud. NARA is a living injured winch repair worker seated on plain stool, one trousered leg supported by simple wooden splints, dark rust work shirt, leather tool belt. No exposed injury or blood. Same characters and garments remain consistent across views; all have compact game-sprite proportions and consistent ground plane. No ghost, undead effect, body in coffin, or heroic pose. Their clothing is an original visual proposal. Focus on readable small silhouettes, not facial detail.
